data.title: Release History - The Go Programming Language
data.description: This page summarizes the changes between official stable releases of Go. Go 1.24 (released 2025-02-11) includes generic type aliases and swiss tables.

data.title: Go 1.24 Release Notes
data.content: The latest Go release, version 1.24, arrives six months after Go 1.23. Most of its changes are in the implementation of the toolchain, runtime, and libraries.
